tagline.en: Echo-Memory's hybrid video-SSM configuration — combining state-space memory with the video backbone for the family's headline recipe.
tagline.zh: Echo-Memory 的视频 SSM 混合配置——将状态空间记忆与视频骨干结合,是该家族的主打配方。

en: Echo-Memory is a memory-augmented world model on the open Wan2.1 diffusion backbone. From a starting image, a text prompt and a camera trajectory it rolls out video of an explorable scene, using a memory mechanism to hold the scene together over long rollouts.

This identity is the video-SSM hybrid: rather than a pure ablation of one knob, it blends a state-space memory module into the video generation path, so remembered scene state and the diffusion backbone work together. It's presented as a primary configuration of the family rather than a single-variable study.

In WorldFoundry you run it through the shared diffusion pipeline with a local Echo-Memory checkpoint, assembled from shared Wan components. It's aimed at memory research and interactive world-model experiments — a good starting point when you want the family's flagship memory recipe rather than a targeted ablation.
zh: Echo-Memory 是构建在开源 Wan2.1 扩散骨干上的记忆增强世界模型。它以起始图像、文字提示词和相机轨迹为输入,推演出可探索场景的视频,并用记忆机制在长程推演中维持场景连贯。
本模型是视频 SSM 混合配置:它不是对单个旋钮的纯消融,而是把状态空间记忆模块融入视频生成路径,让记住的场景状态与扩散骨干协同工作。它被定位为该家族的主打配置,而非单变量研究。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你通过统一扩散 pipeline、配合本地 Echo-Memory checkpoint 运行它,配方由共享 Wan 组件组装而成。它面向记忆机制研究与交互式世界模型实验——当你想要该家族的旗舰记忆配方、而非针对性消融时,是不错的起点。

whenToUse.en: A good default within the Echo-Memory family when you want its flagship hybrid memory recipe rather than an isolated ablation — for exploring camera-controlled, memory-consistent world rollouts.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想用 Echo-Memory 家族的旗舰混合记忆配方、而非孤立的消融时,它是该家族里不错的默认选择——适合探索相机可控、记忆一致的世界推演。

notFor.en: If your goal is to isolate one memory knob, use the targeted SSM or spatial ablations instead. As with the family, you supply a compatible local checkpoint.
notFor.zh: 若你的目标是隔离某一个记忆旋钮,请改用针对性的 SSM 或空间消融版本。与该家族其他成员一样,你需自备兼容的本地 checkpoint。
